claims.assertion: Athena called 3D and 5D human-made, reductive labels; she said her views differ from Taygeta’s.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)

claims.assertion: Athena said individuals perceive their own reality through frequency and shared perception agreements, rather than living in fixed densities.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She said consciousness and mind shape a perceived reality.

claims.assertion: Athena said unseen beings may remain outside ordinary perception yet have physical effects; she cited stones thrown and gravity sensors detecting them.
claims.speaker: Swaruu X (Athena)
claims.qualifiers: She said Yazhi could see them unaided, while she could not.
